verdict.rationale: Numeral's core API model ("give us an address and products, we'll return the accurate tax amount") implies rate/rule maintenance is handled server-side by the vendor without client redeploys, and nexus/threshold monitoring (numeral-docs-10, numeral-docs-32) suggests ongoing jurisdictional tracking. However, there is no explicit documentation of a rate/rule-change changelog, effective-date notices, or confirmation that updates are transparent to ops users — the only changelog evidence (numeral-docs-21) covers API/object schema changes, not tax rate/rule updates. Missing for 10: a dedicated rate/rule update changelog or notification system, explicit effective-date documentation for jurisdiction rule changes, and independent confirmation that calculations stay current without any client action.
